purpose: Non-overwriting audit of cross-platform frozen-input identity verification

observed_issue.finding: The tracked scientific content is unchanged; checkout CRLF expansion alone changed physical working-tree bytes.

verification_rules.canonical_git_text: For explicitly classified Git-tracked protocol text and frozen dependency text/source, replace CRLF byte pairs with LF in memory and require the resulting SHA-256 to equal the pre-existing frozen canonical LF digest. Bare CR, whitespace changes, encoding changes, and all other content changes remain failures.
verification_rules.raw_bytes: Hash physical bytes without transformation and require exact equality with the pre-existing frozen raw SHA-256.

artifact_classification.artifact: frozen dependency source and JSON files named by the preregistration
artifact_classification.semantics: canonical LF SHA-256; neural.py remains the prospectively documented exception
exact raw SHA-256 plus frozen semantic fields
exact raw SHA-256 and size attested by the exact-byte manifest; source is not reopened by this runner

regression_coverage: one-character, whitespace, and other content changes fail
clarification, addendum, and frozen dependency text use canonical LF identity
replay, manifest, and report preserve exact raw-byte identity
